The purpose of this Amendment:

  1. To update all price tables with updated quantity of clin#1 from 7 Breakers to 8 breakers.
  2. To extend the proposal submission due date from March 10, 2026, to  March 16, 2026 by 5PM. No proposals shall be accepted after this time and date.

Except as provided herein, all terms and conditions remain unchanged and in full force and effect.
